007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for dropping a Select AI vector index.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
020 * {@link VectorIndex} object for an existing vector index, call
021 * {@link VectorIndex#drop(boolean, boolean)}, and print whether the drop
022 * operation succeeded.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>This sample changes database state by dropping the vector index identified
025 * by {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME}. Verify the vector index name before
026 * running it.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
029 * <ul>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
034 * </ul>
035 *
036 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
037 * <ul>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DROP_INCLUDE_DATA - set to {@code false} to drop
039 *       only vector-index metadata and keep backing vector data. Defaults to
040 *       {@code true}.</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DROP_FORCE - set to {@code true} to request force
042 *       drop. Defaults to {@code false}.</li>
043 * </ul>
044 *
045 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
046 * <pre>{@code
047 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
048 * }</pre>
049 *
050 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
051 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
052 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
053 * <pre>{@code
054 * mvn clean install
055 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
056 * }</pre>
057 *
058 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
061 *   -d samples/out \
062 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/DropVectorIndexSample.java
063 * }</pre>
064 *
065 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
066 * <pre>{@code
067 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
068 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.DropVectorIndexSample
069 * }</pre>
070 *
071 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
072 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
073 * and diagnostics.</p>
074 */
075public final class DropVectorIndexSample {
076    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DropVectorIndexSample.class);
077
078    private DropVectorIndexSample() {
079    }
080
081    public static void main(String[] args) {
082        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
083        boolean includeData = Boolean.parseBoolean(
084                envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DROP_INCLUDE_DATA", "true"));
085        boolean force = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DROP_FORCE", "false"));
086
087        try {
088            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
089            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(indexName);
090            boolean dropped = vectorIndex.drop(includeData, force);
091
092            System.out.printf("Drop vector index '%s' completed: %s%n", indexName, dropped);
093            System.out.printf("Include backing data : %s%n", includeData);
094            System.out.printf("Force               : %s%n", force);
095        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
096            LOGGER.error("Failed to drop Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
097        }
098    }
099
100    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
101        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
102                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
103                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
104                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
105                .build();
106
107        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
108    }
109
110    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
111        String value = System.getenv(name);
112        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
113            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
114        }
115        return value;
116    }
117
118    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
119        String value = System.getenv(name);
120        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
121    }
122}
